metadata.title: Retro Soft-Lit Portrait with Extruded Art Deco Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait featuring a central subject in dark clothing against a neutral background, paired with top-right aligned, drop-shadowed Art Deco display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up black and white portrait of a man with voluminous feathered hair, wearing a dark turtleneck that blends into a deep black foreground. The lighting is soft but directional, highlighting facial features and hair texture. In the upper right corner, stylized Art Deco text is rendered with a thick, peach-colored 3D extrusion.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with head filling the upper two-thirds
High contrast between the dark clothing/foreground and the neutral grey background
Typography anchored to the top right, balancing the visual weight of the subject's head
Soft lighting creates a smooth gradient on the face while maintaining sharp eye detail
coreInvariants: Extruded 3D typography in a contrasting warm tone

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes, the gaze moves upward to the voluminous hair and then right to the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Neutral grey space surrounding the head, particularly in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white (monochrome) for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grey for the studio background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Peach or muted orange for the typographic extrusion.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; low saturation in the accent color to maintain a vintage feel.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are given a deep, 45-degree downward-left extrusion to create a 3D block effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying line lengths for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric Art Deco feel and tall proportions.
Matches the ultra-condensed, high-waisted look of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white studio portrait of a man with 1970s feathered hair wearing a black turtleneck against a plain grey background. Use soft lighting to emphasize facial structure.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase Art Deco condensed text in the top right corner. Apply a thick peach-colored 3D extrusion effect angled down and to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the text aligned to the top right?
Does the text have a visible 3D depth effect?
Is the lower third of the image solid black?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 3D extrusion direction is consistent.
Ensure the subject's hair has a soft, feathered texture.
Check that the black turtleneck blends seamlessly into the bottom edge.
Confirm the typography does not overlap the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Portrait + Art Deco Condensed Type + 3D Block Extrusion
